title: Earth Defense Force 6.2 Invaders From Another World Game Launches on March 18
content: D3Publisher announced at the Tokyo Game Show 2026 on Friday that it will release Earth Defense Force 6.2 INVADERS FROM ANOTHER WORLD, an updated version of its Earth Defense Force 6 game, on March 18, 2027. The Earth Defense Force 6 game launched in Japan in August 2022 for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5.
